notes.title: Hexxxtension Finale and Game Base Update Inbound!!!
notes.notes:
Heyo everyone! It's been a beautiful past three months ever since we launched onto Steam. One of the overall goals of MonsterxMan Inheritence to Lust was to have a certain amount of Units Shipped and Downloaded; thanks to your amazing support, we have crushed that number! 

As a reward for this, we are launching the full Hexxxtension, a "your choices WILL matter" extension to the main story that is playable post the final boss if you choose. Previously, the Hexxxtension was being released in parts to Windows users only, however come tomorrow, we'll launch the full Hexxxtension for Linux and Mac Users, as well as WIndows users. 

In addition to the Hexxxtension, there have been base game changes to better streamline the game, and add an additional layer of polish as an additional thank you for all your wonderful support so far. 

Things included with the Hexxxtension: 
5 endings! 
Additional 3~4 hours of gameplay! 
Revelation of the D E E P L O R E 
Tie in with a partner studio's title 
More Mongirls! 
More Tracks! 
More Stuffs! 

Can't give a guarantee to the time, but the update will happen tomorrow on Monday, 7-29-2018. 

Keep in mind, as its an update, there are most likely to be bugs abound (even though I spent ALOT of time trying to squash most of the bugs) so make sure to highlight them and mark them down over at Bug Reporting as "Hexxxtension" (Protip; Two of the Endings are NOT bugs, as they are the result of your poor choices.) 

Thank you again for supporting us so far, and please remember; MonsterxMan Inheritance to Lust, along with its Hexxxtension is completely free, and you'll never pay a cent for any of its content. 

It's been a crazy journey, but finally, we're here at the end. 

Please support us in the future as we continue to work on more projects, both in the MonsterxMan series, and in our non MxM series works. 

You've all been amazing! :D 

~Love Lumie~ [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451477/1a81b74c628db8ff6e4bd4e091800a2eae8b8c09.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451477/13d917abf3bea3d178b076bb57349f3ee2f75538.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Something Hexxxy This Way Comes
notes.notes:
Guten Morgen Tout Le Moude. 

While I'm working on the current patch/update that'll rework the achievement system, I'll be adding in something very special (which might delay the process of Monday's build depending on how long it takes for me to do this) 

Introducing: New Game Plus, Hexxxy Edition. 

This will be achieved when you beat the game on the first run with 100% achievements,  This new game plus will essentially be a two person run, only you and Hexxxy. You won't lose any experience or skills, and can play through the story again; however this time, things will be a bit different. Enemies will become MUCH harder, (A standard boss will have the skill set/stat base of a superboss) and some other minor/major story/gameplay things will be changed as well. Also, depending on the time schedule allotted, we'll have lots of dating with Hexxxy; however, don't expect them to be easy whatsoever. This new game plus will be for people who are absolutely insane. 

Oh, and something worth noting; It'll just be you and Hexxxy, none of the other seven get to join. 

I hope you look forward to this new addition!

notes.title: Launch Day and V.1.0.0b!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Thank you for a successful launch day! :D 

We're absolutely overjoyed at the sheer amount of attention we've been getting for our little project, and we're humbled by your kind words. 
*bows head through kotatsu table* 
Thank you. 

Also, quickie update for tonight!
Squashed two bugs! 

Mimic Girl Voice Sound not Loading
Shrine Eternal Fishing. 

Thank you to the players who found it! 
Please view your threads and respond with your in game quote for the next patch :3 

Some other little additions. 
Hints! 

The game is tricky and hard sometimes, so we decided to be nice and drop a few hints. (Both in game and in discussions) 

Areas have a little bit more obvious entrances and exits. 

For players less curious about everything around them, the shopkeeper will now tell you about her cart. 

Also, changed up some linearity. 
You now need the recruit the Shopkeeper before recruiting Orca Girl. Previously, you just needed a fishing pole to recruit Orca Girl. 

Free Farm Fishing at the shrine is now a limited event! If you defeat any of the hidden minibosses, you won't be able to Free Farm anymore! Also, after defeating the Superboss after the three hidden minibosses, Shrine fishing will be dead forever :3 

Hope you enjoy and continue to enjoy! 

If you need anymore hints, or find any bugs, please report them over at the discussions. 

Danke danke, and veil gluck!
